CustomField.description: THE ROSTER STRING AS IT ARRIVED, mangled and all: "Vargas, Jefferson [EMR/SYSS/AT/MEDI]". The stored-form law - wrong text is marked wrong, never deleted - and the practical reason: the parse is ours and can be wrong, and the only way to re-derive a name is to have kept what we derived it from. ASR mangles names (Stacey to "Tracy", Claude to "clogged"), so the source form is the audit trail on every identity decision.
CustomField.label: Source Name
